Devastating Earthquakes Strike Venezuela, Causing Widespread Destruction and Casualties

Two major earthquakes have struck Venezuela, resulting in significant destruction and a rising death toll that has neared 1,500. Satellite imagery reveals widespread damage to buildings and infrastructure, particularly in areas north of Caracas. Humanitarian organizations are calling for aid, with a significant number of children requiring assistance, while some citizens express anger towards the government as rescue efforts continue.
